description: Batch import a client roster into the workspace directory. Accepts raw CSV text (with intelligent auto-mapping across 50+ synonym headers like TaxDome, Drake, QuickBooks, UltraTax, etc.) or an array of client objects. Automatically deduplicates and merges existing profiles by email.

clients.description: Alternative structured array of client objects if already transformed by AI

columnOverrides.description: Optional mapping of standard fields to custom header names in the CSV

csvText.description: Raw CSV text containing client rows to import

name: import_clients_csv
